item.title: Iceberg: Turning a Pile of Files into a Table
item.description: A set of Parquet files in object storage lacks what a database table provides: atomic commits, schema changes, and point-in-time reads. Iceberg restores them by recording the table’s file list in metadata files and treating a pointer swap as the commit. The cost is ongoing maintenance to clean up small files, old snapshots, and orphan files.
